VERDICT: FAIL

The self-report is the only evidence; no CI log, diff, or independent artifact verifies that the bug is fixed or that all 31 tests pass. Acceptance cannot be confirmed on an unverified claim. Additionally, the described fix (retry backoff with max-attempts) addresses retry volume but doesn't obviously prevent duplicate sends, which typically requires idempotency/deduplication—raising doubt the root cause was actually resolved.
